description: This file defines a PangeaGuardrail class for integrating with the Pangea AI Guardrail service within a larger framework. It includes custom exceptions, request handling, API call logic, and guardrail hooks for pre- and post- processing in an async context.

classes.name: PangeaGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Custom exception raised when Pangea secrets are missing.

classes.name: _TextCompletionRequest
classes.description: Helper class for handling text completion requests, allows message retrieval and updating the original request body.

classes.name: PangeaHandler
classes.description: Main class implementing guardrail logic to interact with Pangea AI Guard API, including hooks for request/response processing, error handling, and configuration.

methods.description: Wrapper async method that manages execution of the post-call hook with error handling.
